```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/login', function () {
    return view('auth.login');
});

Route::post('/register', function (Request $request) {
    // Register user logic here
});

Route::get('/dashboard', function () {
    return view('dashboard');
});

Route::get('/todoitem/create', function () {
    return view('todoitem.create');
});
```

In this solution, we have defined routes for the login page, registration page, dashboard page, and a new todo item creation page. Each route corresponds to a specific view file in the views/auth folder for login and register, and in the views/dashboard folder for dashboard and todo item creation.
